name: Charles River
event_blurb:
PathoQuest is a global CRO that specializes in biopharma Quality Control (QC) based on Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) for viral safety and genetic characterization. The company’s proprietary NGS-based testing approach delivers actionable QC reports to the industry for cell & gene therapy, vaccines and biologics. 
With a proven track record, our expert team can support fast and robust QC testing at a GMP grade over two facilities in Europe (Paris, FR) and in the U.S. (Wayne, PA). 
PathoQuest is at the forefront of NGS-based testing solutions that accelerate the commercial availability of biopharmaceuticals and can replace current standardized in vivo and in vitro testing options. 
Biopharma Quality Control  
Faster, Safer, Animal-Free.

name: Forma Life Sciences
event_blurb: Forma Life Sciences is a U.S.-based CDMO delivering oral solid dosage development and manufacturing from clinical through commercial scale. With two cGMP facilities in Irvine, California, Forma combines advanced formulation technologies with scalable manufacturing expertise to help pharmaceutical and biotech companies bring therapies to market.

name: Halden Pharma
event_blurb:
Your Global CDMO for Sterile Liquids.
Halden Pharma delivers high-quality contract manufacturing services for sterile and non-sterile pharmaceuticals, specializing in IV bags and BFS ampoules and vials for global pharmaceutical customers. name: Just - Evotec Biologics
event_blurb:
Just – Evotec Biologics, a wholly owned subsidiary of Evotec SE, is an innovative and trusted US-based CDMO for complex biologics, incl. mAbs, bi/multispecifics, and biosimilars. We provide our partners with highly differentiated services for the development and manufacturing of biologics.
Our world-leading AI-driven in silico molecular optimization and continuous bioprocessing platforms combined with our revolutionary J.POD® facilities, which represent a paradigm shift within the industry, are helping to reduce the cost of goods and expand global access to affordable, high-quality biotherapeutics in addition to providing a highly agile cGMP manufacturing strategy to support rapid ramp up and uncertain demand scenarios.

name: ROIS
event_blurb:
ROIS is a global leader in sterile fill-finish manufacturing operating across the United States and Europe supporting end-to-end, late-phase and commercial programs for complex injectable medicines.
The CDMO brings more than 50 years of experience in sterile filling of vials, syringes, and cartridges and has recently expanded to include cytotoxic vial filling and lyophilization, both capable of supporting ADCs. name: Sterling Pharma Solutions
event_blurb:
Sterling Pharma Solutions is a global contract development and manufacturing organisation (CDMO) with 50+ years’ experience in providing small molecule API development and manufacturing services to the pharmaceutical industry, specialising in handling challenging chemistries.
Sterling manages the most complex API and API intermediate challenges from proof-of-concept to commercial manufacture, as well as Antibody Drug Conjugate (ADC) development and manufacturing services.
Sterling believes that while science can be complex, partnerships should be simple. That’s why they have redefined the CDMO experience, marked by transparency, collaboration and trust; a Partnership Development and Manufacturing Organisation (PDMO®).
